column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - semantic WIP identities for all carveable non-vendored functions.
# Address-only func_ names are unresolved; candidate signatures require caller/callee review.
# Methods use name=owner_action with the owner and action columns populated.

MATRIX = Rx * Rz * Ry. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.

Pause screen: enters the menu display, pauses the sequence, shows the pause label until the start action button (DAT_80081868[13]) is pressed, then resumes. No KF2 copy (KF2 has its CD-wait animation func_8001883c in this slot).
Root menu: player status + six-button page (USE ITEM, USE MAGIC, EQUIPMENT, STATUS/RECORDS, STORAGE, SYSTEM); R1+L1 shows the location number; a 0x1000-tagged result selects that spell.
Draws area*10000 + cell x*100 + cell z as a six-digit number.
USE ITEM list (items 95..149): map/note items open their picture, item 133 opens the warp map (result 150+n), consumables go through menu_apply_item_effect on exit.
Copies the name row, count and id of every item in [first,last] whose count in the given table is nonzero; returns the row count.
As menu_collect_masked_item_rows but subtracts one for each equipped slot holding the item (two for a doubly worn accessory) and skips items left at zero.
Rows for owned items whose guide level byte (DAT_80081780[item]) is 5. "Locked" is a reading: 5 is above the player value (+0x4c) the guide compares against.
Applies a consumable (HP/MP restores, poison cure, status clears), clamps HP/MP, decrements the count (two potions also return item 118) and plays the item sound.
Clears paralysis and poison, caps slow at 64, then caps curse and darkness.
Caps the darkness value (+0x7e) at 64 and clears its limit (+0x80).
Caps the curse value (+0x7a) at 64 and clears its limit (+0x7c).
Loads the picture of a map/note item (ITEM entries 0x2f1..0x2f3) through the menu CD reader and shows it (item 95 in areas < 12 with the player marker) until a button is pressed.
Draws the loaded picture of item 95/99/other as an opaque and a translucent quad, shaded by brightness and the PANEL option.
Area map item (96): loads ITEM entry 721+area, reveals visited rects, draws them with the facing marker over a backdrop until a button is pressed.
Draws each of the area's 160 map rects whose revealed bit is set in DAT_801b56cc[area].
Sets an area-map rect's revealed bit when any map cell inside it has its visited bit set (DAT_801b594c).

USE MAGIC list of usable spells (23..30) with MP cost; returns the spell id tagged 0x1000.
Rows (name, MP cost +0x16, id) for spells in [first,last] whose record +0 is 1.
EQUIPMENT page: ten slot rows with the equipped names; row 1 -> magic shortcut, row 9 -> item/magic button, others -> category list.
Fills the ten equipped-name rows (magic names for slot 1 and a magic secondary shortcut, item names otherwise; empty when 0xff).
Lists owned items of one slot's id range plus TAKE OFF, prompts, then equips through player_equip_weapon (weapon) or player_set_equipment_slot (other slots).
Spell list 0..22 plus TAKE OFF; sets the magic slot (+0xc7) through player_set_primary_magic_shortcut_id.
Combined item (101..146, item 133 hidden) and spell list for the item/magic button slot; sets both shortcuts.
STATUS/RECORDS page: OFFENSE/DEFENSE or CONVERSATION.
Shows the offense/defense screen until a button is pressed.
CONVERSATION viewer: left/right picks a recorded character, up/down steps through that character's recorded talk pages; an empty screen when none.
Uploads STALK entry 840+character, lists the character's recorded talk pages (conversation_record_page_entry not 0xfffd..0xffff) into OUT and returns the count.
Clears the page area in VRAM (960,256 64x200) and uploads the STALK image of one recorded talk page.
STORAGE page: STORE or TAKE OUT, with the menu CD reader installed.
Moves QTY of an item from the bag into storage (refused below QTY or at 100 stored).
Moves QTY of an item from storage back into the bag (refused at 100 carried).
SYSTEM page: load (-3 when loaded), the two option pages, button config, quit (-2: stops the CD and fades the music under PLEASE WAIT).
Scans the card, lists the saves, prompts, reads the chosen slot; a failure shows CANNOT LOAD/DATA ERROR. 0 on success.
Builds a row (save number, experience, level and slot number for each valid save among 15 directory entries.
Draws a dialog for two frames: optional title (message < 8), rows, window, optional return hint.
OPTION 1: three sliders (SE volume with a test sound, BGM volume applied live, brightness); stores them on exit.
OPTION 2: two three-way rows and three on/off rows (+0xf9..+0xfc, +0x100); stores them and reapplies the colours.
Sets the menu sprite shade and text colour words (DAT_8009c26c..c27c) from brightness (+0xfd) and the PANEL option (+0x100).
BUTTON CONFIG: picks the action style (0..3) and move layout (0..6), then applies them.

QUIT GAME prompt (YES/NO); YES writes 1 to PSX.EXE's mailbox byte 0x800102f8 and returns 0.
Start-up card check: probes the card (card-required rows on failure, free-block rows when full); if OPEN chose load (mailbox 0x800102fa == 1) runs the load browser. -1 when no game was loaded.
Lists the saves, prompts, reads the chosen slot; failure dialog on error.

One pad poll for a button page: up/down wraps the selection, confirm sets CHOSEN, cancel sets RESULT -1.

One pad poll for a list: scrolls the cursor (requests the item model), left/right change the quantity with gold/stock checks (mode 1 buy, 2 sell/store), confirm/cancel; select/start nudge the preview (debug).
Root status window: experience, level, HP, MP, stats, five icon-labelled values (+0x42), condition, gold.
OFFENSE/DEFENSE screen: attack and defence values by type and element.
Conversation screen: window, button hints and, for a character (not -1), the talk page image, the name strip and the character's name.
BUTTON CONFIG screen: button icons with the action and move assignments for the style and layout, highlighted row.
OPTION 2 rows: the selected choice box pulses for two three-way rows, the ON/OFF rows and the CLEAR/SOLID panel row.
Three slider bars with a knob at level*96/128.
Two-option prompt over a list with the item preview; the labels depend on KIND. 0 accept, -1 decline or cancel.
Triangle guide: shows ITEM picture item+390 (item+540 when the item's guide level exceeds player +0x4c; spell+690 in mode 1) until cancel.
Draws a button page (title and COUNT rows from DAT_8007e660 + page*9), the selected row pulsing, plus the select/return hints.
Draws a list window: title, visible rows with the mode's extra columns (counts, prices, MP, second names, card data), cursor, gold/QTY, hint bar.
Draws the two prompt labels with the chosen one pulsing.
Steps the async item model read (checksum, TMD register) and draws the rotating lit model when the ITEMS option is on.
Draws QTY and the current quantity; BIG also draws GOLD and moves QTY down.
Draws GOLD and the player's gold.
Draws a frame sprite behind a text record (at x-6, y-6), translucent when the PANEL option says so.
As menu_blit_panel_sprite with a brightness that pulses with SHADE (the selection highlight).

Draws a window of corner, edge and fill tiles for x,y,w,h. KF3 has no overlap arguments.
Draws a fixed VRAM texture (u 0, v 0x30, 128x200) stretched over x,y,w,h twice (PANEL-dependent, then additive). Only the area map uses it.
Flips the buffer, clears the OT and primitive pool, sets the screen-copy rect and steps the pulse counters.
DrawSync/VSync, puts the envs, reloads the saved screen copy, draws the OT.
Frees pooled data, disables background clear, splits the primitive pools, stores the screen copy, saves the BGM state, applies the colours and confirm/cancel buttons.
Restores the pools and background clear; mode 1 stops the sequence, otherwise starts/stops it when BGM was toggled.
Takes a POLY_FT4 from the frame pool (DAT_8009c374) and inits it with the text colour.

AddPrim of the current POLY_FT4 at an OT depth.

Formats VALUE into digit glyphs with padding and the style's prefix/suffix glyphs.
Cursor/confirm/cancel sounds (12..14) or the two-part item sound (9).

Clears the pending flag and waits until no button is held.
Waits until any button is pressed. KF2 inlines this loop.
Resets QTY to 1 and, when the ITEMS option is on, queues ITEM for the async model read.
Releases the old model, allocates the queued item's ITEM entry and starts its read; resets the preview position, rotation and spin.
Frees the registered model (TMD slot 3) or the in-flight read buffer and clears both flags.
Waits for the CD queue to idle and swaps the data-ready event and CdReadyCallback to menu_cd_data_ready_handler.
Waits for the menu read, releases the model, restores cd_data_ready_handler and pauses the drive.
Pauses, sets double speed and issues ReadN at an archive entry's position; returns its sector count.
Waits (VSync(2)) while the menu CD read is in progress (DAT_8009c230 == 1).

Opens and enables the four BIOS card events (I/O end, timeout, new card, error). KF2 also points the card buffer at static storage here; KF3 allocates it in memory_card_start.
Closes the four card events and stops the card BIOS. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT (as KF2's copy is clear and distinct, named; note uncalled).

Formats bu00:; returns 1 on failure.

Writes the save number, experience and level into the header title as Shift-JIS digits.
Byte sum of the 0x5c00-byte save payload.
Spins until a card event fires: 0 I/O end, 1 timeout, 2 new card, 3 error.

Stores the player's clearance to the three collision-cache bounds (DAT_801d4464.unk12018[0..2] + 1600); below -1000 / at or under 0 starts death (player_death_begin). KF2 checks two bounds.
vector_distance_to_point from the player with radius + 800 and the player height 1700 (the collision query's player test).

After a load: re-applies armour slots, weapon and both magic shortcuts, resets the view, respawns the active boost effects, recalculates stats and the button config.
For the 32 model slots of an area (556 + area*32), marks each loaded arena block reclaimable (kind 1) unless it is still loading. No KF2 counterpart.

Waits for the CD, invalidates the five area ids, requests areas 0..2 (+ an optional part) through resource_request_transition, re-syncs the player, lights and overlays, fades, then requests areas 3/4.
(value << 6) / (rank + 1) + 1, capped at 5000: the magic charge gain per frame.

While the player owns item 0 or 1, remembers the experience at first sight; once experience passes it by 13000, equips the next weapon (if the held one is 0 or 1), swaps the item for the next one and shows message 4. "Grow" is a reading of the stage swap.
Adds experience (max 999999) and levels up from the 12-byte level table (HP/MP max, power, random magic gains, next threshold), message 0, learns magic, recalculates.
One damage term from attack vs defence scaled by the damage scale.
HP += delta with no upper clamp; 0 or below starts death. (Poison tick.)
Takes damage from HP, sets the red overlay, and starts a knockback (moving or rotation-only) away from the origin, or death at 0 HP.
By mask: caps curse/darkness/slow at 64 and clears their limits, clears poison and paralysis (same masks as KF2).

Eye position (pos + view offsets - 1600) and view angles for the renderer.
Clears every status/boost timer, refills HP and MP, resets the view.
New-game player: level 1 stats from the level table, no armour, weapon 0 and starting armour, shortcuts cleared, start position, all magic unlearned except one, then player_reset_status.
Sets the weapon model buffer, player_initialize_state, default volumes and options, applies the button config.
Zeroes turn/look/walk/strafe speeds and drops held buttons except four action bits.
Snaps the player to the floor of the current layer, updates the bounds, resets motion state and adds the player to the map cell occupancy.
Player distance from a point (height ignored), -1 when the player is outside the facing cone.
vector_distance_to_point from the player with the player height 1700.
Sets the primary magic shortcut (+0xc7); KF3 also queues the magic's sound bank when it is not loaded.
Sets the secondary magic shortcut (+0xc8), queues its sound bank, and clears the secondary item shortcut.
Sets the secondary item shortcut (+0xc9) and clears the secondary magic shortcut.
Writes an armour id to one of seven slots, refreshes the seven armour record pointers, recalculates stats.
Equips a weapon: record pointer, model read into the weapon buffer and registered, weapon sound bank, attack state reset; two flags unlock fixed magic sets; recalculates.

Magic origin in world space, the best entity in the view cone (stored as the view target, retargeted), and the scaled forward vector.

Starts a magic: gear cost modifiers, MP and charge checks, per-id guards, then queues it with cast count, interval and origin offset.
Moves the player along a heading with collision retries (floor push, pushing objects, wall points, shorter steps, axis slides, slope slides); 1 when moved freely.

Moves the player along the reaction motion vector with gravity, sliding with friction on contact; 1 when it stops/lands.

Springs the three reaction rotation offsets back to 0.
Renders one frame with two HUD options off, then releases the pool (before the menu opens).
